whenToUse.title: When to Use FFmpeg Tools
whenToUse.useFFmpeg: Use FFmpeg tools when the user requests:
useCases: Video format conversion (MP4, WebM, AVI, etc.)
whenToUse.doNotUse: DO NOT use FFmpeg tools for:
doNotUseCases: Adding elements to the timeline → use `add_element_to_timeline`

paths.title: Absolute Paths Required
paths.description: All file paths MUST start with `/` (e.g., `/video.mp4`)

services.title: Service Availability
services.description: Check if EditorCore and FFmpegService are available

response.title: Unified Response Format
response.description: All tools return `{ success: boolean, message: string, data?: any }`

errorHandling.title: Error Handling
errorHandling.description: Always validate parameters and handle errors gracefully

basic.name: Basic
basic.useCases: Execute commands, check status, verify files

export.name: Export
export.useCases: Export timeline, get info, generate thumbnails

notes.title: Important Notes
notes.longRunning: Long-running operations: Video processing can take seconds to minutes. Inform the user about progress.
notes.qualityPresets: Quality presets: Use `quality: "high"` for final exports, `"low"` for previews
notes.batchOperations: Batch operations: Use `batch_convert_format` for multiple files
notes.advancedUsers: Advanced users: `execute_ffmpeg_command` provides full FFmpeg control but requires knowledge of FFmpeg CLI
